Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)

constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero

banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)

constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: بتربط transformations وما بيحصلش حاجة هو بيبني graph للي إنت طلبته.
sentences.en: You chain transformations and nothing runs — it is building a graph of what you asked for.

sentences.ar: ولما تنادي action بس، ساعتها بيخطط وينفّذ، والتأخير ده هو اللي بيخليه يحسّن على السلسلة كلها بدل خطوة خطوة.
sentences.en: Only when you call an action does it plan and execute, and that delay is what lets it optimise across the whole chain instead of one step at a time.

sentences.ar: والـscheduler بيقطّع الـgraph ده لـstages، وبيقطّع بالظبط عند أي shuffle مطلوب.
sentences.en: The scheduler cuts that graph into stages, and it cuts exactly where a shuffle is required.

sentences.ar: الـnarrow transformation بيخلّي كل partition مستقلة؛ والـwide لازم ينقل داتا بين الأجهزة، وده حدّ مرحلة.
sentences.en: A narrow transformation keeps each partition independent; a wide one has to move data between machines, and that is a stage boundary.

sentences.ar: فلما حد يطلب منك تقرا Spark plan، المهارة مش إنك تسمّي operators المهارة إنك تشاور على الـshuffles وتقول ليه.
sentences.en: So when someone asks you to read a Spark plan, the skill is not naming operators — it is pointing at where the shuffles are and saying why.
A partition is the unit of work.

sentences.ar: قليلة أوي، وأغلب الـcluster قاعد فاضي.
sentences.en: Too few and most of your cluster is idle.

sentences.ar: كتير أوي، وبتدفع overhead جدولة على آلاف الـtasks الصغيّرة.
sentences.en: Too many and you pay scheduling overhead on thousands of tiny tasks.

sentences.ar: ودلوقتي الـfailure اللي شكلها cluster بطيء وهي مش كده.
sentences.en: Now the failure that looks exactly like a slow cluster and is not.

sentences.ar: ميتين task خلصوا بسرعة، وواحدة ماشية.
sentences.en: Two hundred tasks finish quickly, and one keeps going.

sentences.ar: كل الـexecutors التانيين فاضيين وعمود واحد طالع.
sentences.en: Every other executor is idle while a single bar climbs.

sentences.ar: ده الـskew: key واحد أكبر بكتير من الباقي، فـtask واحدة خدت أغلب الداتا.
sentences.en: That is skew: one key is far larger than the rest, so one task got most of the data.

sentences.ar: وإنك تضيف أجهزة ما بيعملش حاجة خالص، لأن المشكلة توزيع مش سعة.
sentences.en: Adding machines does nothing at all, because the problem is distribution, not capacity.

sentences.ar: اعمل repartition، أو salting للـkey الحامي، أو broadcast للناحية الصغيّرة من الـjoin عشان ما يبقاش في shuffle يتـskew أصلاً.
sentences.en: Repartition, or salt the hot key, or broadcast the small side of the join so there is no shuffle to skew.

sentences.ar: ولاحظ إن ده رجّعنا لنفس مكان الـSQL tuning: الأداء بيبدأ من شكل الداتا والـplan، مش من جهاز أكبر.
sentences.en: And notice that this lands us back where SQL tuning did: performance starts with the shape of the data and the plan, not with a bigger machine.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

referenced.ctx: One hot key makes a 200-task stage wait on a single straggler;

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.

concepts.def_en: Spark records transformations as a plan and runs nothing until an action, like count or write, requests a result; this lets it optimise.
concepts.def_ar: الـlazy evaluation يعني Spark بيسجّل الـtransformations كخطة ومبينفذش حاجة لحد ما action تتنادي، وده بيخليه يحسّن الخطة.
concepts.failure: Expecting a transformation to run at once; errors and slowness only surface at the action.

concepts.def_en: Apache Spark: a distributed engine that processes large datasets in parallel across a clu…
concepts.failure: Using Spark for small data, where cluster overhead outweighs any speed gain.

concepts.def_en: A set of nodes connected by edges, used to model relationships such as roads, dependencie…
concepts.failure: Confusing a graph (nodes and edges) with a chart (plotted data).

concepts.def_en: A component that decides which task runs when and where, based on schedules, dependencies…
concepts.failure: Expecting the scheduler to execute tasks itself; workers do the execution.

concepts.def_en: Redistributing data across machines over the network so rows with the same key land toget…
concepts.failure: Treating shuffle as free; it moves data over the network and dominates job time.

concepts.def_en: A slice of data split by key or range, so work touches only part of it; in window functio…
concepts.failure: Choosing a partition key queries never filter on, so nothing is pruned.

concepts.def_en: One unit of work in a DAG (an Airflow step or a Spark computation on one partition), run,…
concepts.failure: Making tasks non-idempotent, so a retry duplicates side effects such as double inserts.

concepts.def_en: Uneven distribution where one key holds most of the data, so one partition's task runs fa…
concepts.failure: Adding executors to fix it; the one hot key still lands on one task.

concepts.def_en: Adding a random suffix to a hot key so its rows spread across several partitions, fixing data skew in joins and aggregations.
concepts.def_ar: الـsalting إنك تضيف لاحقة عشوائية للـkey الحامي عشان صفوفه تتوزع على partitions كتير، وده بيحل الـskew في الـjoins والـaggregations.
concepts.failure: Salting one side only; the other side must be expanded to match every salt.

concepts.def_en: Combines rows from two tables by matching key columns, such as orders with their customer…
concepts.failure: Joining on a non-unique key silently multiplies rows and inflates totals.

concepts.def_en: Structured Query Language: the standard declarative language for querying and changing da…
concepts.failure: Thinking SQL runs in written order; the engine plans execution in its own order.
